subject: Donald Trump
license: VoteHub rows CC BY 4.0; Pollfinity rows per Pollfinity terms
method: FEA weighted Trump job-approval average from multiple public feeds (VoteHub individual polls, CC BY 4.0, plus Pollfinity’s published poll list). Identical surveys are collapsed across sources by pollster/date/result before weighting. Soft exponential recency decay with no short hard cutoff. When recent polling is thin, the half-life lengthens (about 14→45 days). Within each pollster, polls are recency-weighted; pollsters are then weighted by the recency of their latest poll. LV beats RV beats adults when the same release reports multiple populations. Internals excluded. ENOP is the sum of raw pollster weights before normalization. This is FEA’s own aggregate, not VoteHub’s or Pollfinity’s published average.
